description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Ice 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Icy Vessel Mode] to the user

description.name: Glass Dance
description.text: 4/8 single attacks (3.05 each) if the user hasn't/has Icy Vessel, grants [Quick Cast 1] if the user hasn't Icy Vessel

description.name: Heavenly Strike
description.text: One single attack (16.40) capped at 99999, grants [Quick Cast 1], restores 1 consumed ability use to the user

description.name: Attach Ice 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Icy Vessel Mode
description.text: Grants [Icy Vessel] after using three of Glass Dance or Heavenly Strike, removed after triggering

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
